text: Everything this program built lives inside Purview, invisible to the Council unless they log in. This video builds a second dashboard: a governance-health scorecard.
Four tiles: how much of five sources is scanned, how much is classified, whether Active Customer is actually used, and whether our data quality rules pass.
Purview already writes scan, classification, and glossary insights nightly to a managed storage account. Power BI connects directly -- no new pipeline needed.
The fourth tile reads from the governance-reporting export we already built. Validated by hand against Purview's own screen before anyone else sees it.
The scorecard refreshes nightly. Next: taking it, and a real classification gap, into the room with leadership.
